versions.subject: feat: updates and enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\SharpLDAPmonitor.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'SharpLDAPmonitor.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/user:'
        - '/pass:'
        - '/dcip:'
condition: 1 of selection_*
